name: Bidirectional Projective Sampling
aliases: Projective sampling with emitter-emitted seed rays
definition: An augmentation of previous projective-sampling-based boundary-sampling methods in a bidirectional manner, utilizing rays spawned from sensors and rays emitted by emitters to initialize the guiding structure for calculating gradients efficiently in physics-based differentiable rendering.
summary: Bidirectional Projective Sampling is a boundary sampling method that generates seed rays from both sensors and emitters to efficiently handle small-area lights in differentiable rendering.
